nb2_lite.texto: A few Board of Reference members, fair-skinned Australian men in their forties and fifties in short-sleeved shirts, ties and felt hats; lean European-migrant mill workers in singlets coated grey from head to boot. The inspecting men pause mid-stride inside the mill as dust falls from a conveyor, one jotting notes. Men of European descent with fair to olive skin, light to dark brown or black hair, varied eye colour and lean, labour-hardened builds. 1957 Wittenoom mill interior: belt-driven machinery, conveyors, newly added dust ducting, corrugated-iron walls. Hard sun shafts through roof gaps, beams thick with dust. Medium shot, eye-level, 35mm lens, moderate depth of field. A grainy 35mm documentary photograph in the style of 1957, with muted colors and slight underexposure, in a dark-history realist style. The image has a 16:9 aspect ratio. No readable text, no signage, no labels.
